title: Cipher and Border
author: Emrys Whitlock
blurb: Ulyana Okafor, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
